title: Hanyu Chengyu Yuanliu
subtitle: 汉语成语源流大辞典
description: Find out where a Chinese idiom comes from and how it’s used. The original story or meaning can help you remember an expression that’s hard to guess from its characters.

fields.label: Meaning
fields.text: 比喻荣枯得失无常，虚幻不实；也泛指一场梦。

fields.label: Origin · 《南柯太守传》
fields.text: 梦至此而醒，发现庭前槐树下有一蚁洞，即梦中的槐安国都；南柯郡是槐树南枝之下的另一蚁穴。
